trust_decision.summary: Whether a user-supplied 'returnto' value (query param, or the 'returnto' state cookie) is an on-site URL safe to redirect to, decided in HttpUtils.getBackToUrl by a case-insensitive string prefix check against serverUrl+contextPath.

landing_point.why: The advisory title names getBackToUrl() and the startsWith check; that line is the only prefix comparison in it.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /signin?returnto= (SigninController.java:75,81) plus post-auth redirects in SigninController.java:123,176,313,318,356,369; GET /questions/space[/{space}] (QuestionsController.java:315,336,343); POST /profile/toggle-editor-role (ProfileController.java:436-444)
fix_sites.module_kind: shared utility helper (utils package) called by several controllers

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The published fix touches only HttpUtils.getBackToUrl; every published route reaches the sink through that one helper.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: AdminController's POST /admin force-delete is an admin-only action that never calls getBackToUrl, so a solver can argue its 'returnto' redirect is a separate admin feature, not the 'getBackToUrl' bug.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Relative on-site return paths (e.g. /questions/..., /people from the profile delete link) and same-origin absolute URLs, including an explicit default port, must still redirect, and the relative=true path must still relativize. A fix that rejects every absolute URL or every value with a scheme breaks the post-login return and the OAuth onboarding cookie set to an absolute serverUrl.

O6_input_shapes: port mismatch and explicit default port (fix.diff:98-102)

O7_producer.where: src/main/java/com/erudika/scoold/controllers/SigninController.java:81 stores the getBackToUrl result in the 'returnto' state cookie, which is read back at src/main/java/com/erudika/scoold/utils/HttpUtils.java:335

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /admin (forceDelete) redirects to the raw 'returnto' request parameter with no validation, and the redirect runs even when the caller is not an admin
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Admin-only delete feature in another controller that never uses getBackToUrl; the advisory names only getBackToUrl.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file and package (controllers vs utils) from the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: signout redirect taking a 'returnto' or 'next' parameter that falls back to the signout_url config
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Signout already redirects to the configurable signout_url (ScooldConfig.java:3394-3403); a per-request override is a common feature request.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second space-switch handler that builds the back URL from req.getParameter("returnto") directly instead of through getBackToUrl
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: AdminController.java:370 already shows a maintainer reading 'returnto' directly for a convenience redirect.

O9_family: open redirect (CWE-601), URL origin validation by string prefix

O10_build.toolchain: Maven, Spring Boot 4.1 (pom.xml), JUnit 4 per the fix's test
services: Para backend (needed by the full app; not needed for unit tests of HttpUtils)
O10_build.project_tests: No tests for HttpUtils or the redirects at the pinned commit; src/test contains only avatar tests and ScooldUtilsEmailTest. The fix adds src/test/java/com/erudika/scoold/utils/HttpUtilsTest.java (fix.diff:118-243).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Append a trailing '/' to serverUrl in the startsWith check at HttpUtils.java:343, which still misses the AdminController route and may still pass userinfo forms.

out_of_scope_notes: No CSRF token handling is visible in this repo's Java sources (grep for csrf found nothing); not pursued.
The fixed check compares only origin and drops the serverContextPath prefix the old check required (fix.diff:78); this is a behaviour change, not pursued.
